Dear Mr. Dave Ramsey. You might not care about my opinion and that would be sad. I have a lot of respect for you and your teachings , but at times I have difficulty listening to you due to all the harsh and demeaning words that you use- all the "freaking this and that" and, "that's stupid!" and "you're stupid!" You just sound so angry and bitter at times! And it's not that my purpose is to publicly point a finger or criticize but I would sincerely, from the bottom of my heart continue to listen to your teachings, but it comes across in a harsh way which grieves my spirit. I am not going to apologize for trying to sound spiritual which is not my intention, but when we allow the Holy Spirit to change us, it does change us to the point that even such expressions may be hard to take. Not trying to sound smarter or wiser but hoping that you'll accept correction from this sister in Christ. May your messages be edifying in every aspect, to all people, ages and personalities who are willing to listen. You know what Ephesians 4:29-31 says.  We're the light of this world, let us not act as the world.
